# Trump to begin sending $500 ACA refund checks to 1 million Americans

![Portrait of Joey Garrison](/gcdn/presto/2023/09/05/USAT/4d13755c-843c-4565-98e0-c6a4293e9005-Garrison_head_shot.jpg?crop=874,874,x0,y17&width=48&height=48&format=pjpg&auto=webp)
![](/gcdn/authoring/authoring-images/2026/09/30/USAT/92023516007-1.png?crop=1078,605,x0,y134&width=660&height=372&format=pjpg&auto=webp)

WASHINGTON – President [Donald Trump](/news/politics/donald-trump/) is set on Sept. 30 to start sending $500 checks to nearly 1 million Americans [his administration says were overcharged](/story/news/politics/2026/09/10/trump-500-refunds-obamacare/91689019007/) through the Affordable Care Act's federal exchange for buying health insurance.

Treasury Department checks, along with letters signed by Trump notifying recipients, will begin going out to more than 950,000 Americans across 30 states, according to an administration official.
